subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or require a different user/model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible and default-preserving, but it expands the public model/tool contract and includes session-admission behavior that needs maintainer API and product ownership.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once owner review and current-head CI are clean.

options.title: Request a different append API
options.body: Ask the PR to use a dedicated append tool or mode-style field if maintainers want stricter semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a safer replacement
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if another append-mode candidate becomes merged or clearly safer with comparable proof.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once owner review and current-head CI are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the agent runtime/tool API boundary involved in this decision.
